sources.title: 【台股研究報告】欣銓(3264)車用需求將迎來復甦，攜手全球大客戶為營運加速！
sources.locator: Sections “公司簡介” and “欣銓車用五大客戶，在全球車用半導體市場維持高市佔率！”
sources.note: Names Renesas, TI, and Infineon and describes close cooperation; the report is secondary, not an issuer confirmation.

sources.title: 車用、高階需求護體 欣銓下半年營運看穩
sources.effective_period: Reports 2022 H1 revenue mix and customer relationships.
sources.locator: Paragraph beginning “欣銓為專業半導體測試廠”
sources.note: Lists TI, NXP, STMicro, Infineon, and Renesas among important IDM customers; describes automotive/ security as an application category.

sources.title: 欣銓科技大舉投資285億元 強化半導體測試服務產能
sources.effective_period: General company/customer relationship statement; no automotive-specific period given.
sources.locator: Company description in the Ministry of Economic Affairs announcement.
sources.note: Officially describes the company as an important strategic partner to multiple global heavyweight customers, but does not identify automotive IC customers or confirm designated testing status.

sources.title: [TW] 3264 欣銓 – 歷年法說會
sources.locator: “車用電子” item 4; author describes a summary of four investor calls.
sources.note: Says the five largest automotive IDM vendors were customers and that 欣銓 was an important Asian partner for Tier 1 automotive IC vendors, sometimes the only one. This is a secondary personal summary, not the original issuer disclosure, and does not establish formal designation terms.

search_notes: Isolated Hermes Agent run using gpt-6-luna with xhigh reasoning and web tools.

Focused searches and source checks located relevant customer and market-share context, but no official evidence for the claimed testing-services market share or formal designation. Further inference from the customers’ MCU market share would substitute a different denominator.
The located “over 80%” figure refers to the combined automotive MCU market share of five customer IDMs, not 欣銓’s share of automotive MCU testing services.
The reports identifying automotive IDM customers are secondary sources. Customer relationships do not by themselves establish a testing-market share or formal designation.
No official issuer or regulator disclosure located in this research establishes the claimed testing-market denominator, measurement period, or greater-than-80% figure.
